senses.gloss: m. (denom. of מֶכֶס) revenue farmer, publican, custom-collector (considered a robber in Jewish law).
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 113a:15">B. Kam. 113ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ שאין לו קיצבה</he> a publican who is not limited by legal stipulations; <he>מ׳ העומד מאליו</he> a self-constituted collector.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 39a:18">Ab. Zar. 39ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bekhorot 30b:18">Bekh. 30ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>קשרי מ׳</he> the publican’s knots (seals or written receipts); a. e.—Pl. <he>מוֹכְסִין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 10:2">B. Kam. X, 2</cite> <he>נטלו מ׳ וכ׳</he> if publicans took away his ass and gave him one taken from somebody else.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 10:1">Ib. 1</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 10:22">Tosef. ib. X, 22</cite> <he>תיבת מ׳</he> the treasury of the publicans.
<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 3:4">Ned. III, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Nedarim 2:2">Tosef. ib. II, 2</cite>, v. <cite ref="N00239"><he>נָדַר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 8:2">Sabb. VIII, 2</cite> <he>נייר … קשר מ׳</he> paper large enough to write on it a tax-receipt (v. supra).
<cite ref="Shevuot 39a:19">Shebu. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>אין לך … כולה מ׳</he> there is no family in which there is a publican, whose members may not all be considered as publicans (in Jewish law); a. fr.
